title: Write unit tests for prdWriter.ts
description: Write Vitest unit tests for prdWriter.ts covering all cases: new section creation, appending to existing section, existing content preservation, idempotency, and empty PRD handling.
acceptanceCriteria: Spec appended under '## Features Added' when section doesn't exist test passes
Spec appended under existing '## Features Added' without duplicating heading test passes
Existing PRD content before the section is unchanged test passes
Running prdWriter twice with same spec does not produce duplicate block test passes
Empty PRD file handled gracefully test passes
All prdWriter unit tests pass with npm test

steps.details: Create test file with temp dir setup. Write PRD.md files to temp dirs and call writeFeatureSpec.
Create PRD.md without '## Features Added'. Call writeFeatureSpec. Verify file ends with the section and spec content.
Create PRD.md with existing '## Features Added'. Call writeFeatureSpec. Verify spec is appended without duplicating heading. Call again — verify no duplication.
Run `npm test` and verify all prdWriter tests pass.
